purpose: Independent anatomical gates and review criteria for derived educational TEE CT planes; not a clinical diagnostic protocol or a validated registration.

globalInterpretation: The exact CT pixel samples are measured source data, but named-view correspondence and probe anatomy are authored educational interpretations.

The LV lumen is collapsed in the measured sections; the donor imaging publication also identifies collapsed LA. Healthy clinical echo cavity shape or brightness is not a valid direct similarity objective.
Six regional labels indicate approximate tissue ownership. They do not validate individual valve leaflets, pulmonary veins, caval veins, atrial appendages or blood pools.
A numeric plane-fit score is a search heuristic over available landmarks, not a percentage of clinical correctness.
ASE electronic multiplane angle is relative to a probe at an acquisition site; it is not the angle between a CT plane and the scanner axes.
Source imaging planes and prepared pixels remain immutable. Improved active planes are new derived frames with exact newly sampled corresponding CT.
The original baseline remains separately reviewable; source cleanup and measured-density arrays are outside this QC scope.
The user-requested organs are illustrative reference anatomy. They are not donor segmentations or clinical probe-registration measurements.

candidateSelectionOrder.gate: Verify source identity, finite orthonormal frame and in-bounds resampling; reject mismatched prepared texture or donor.
Assess required anatomical connection topology; classify retained, uncertain, truncated or absent targets separately.
Reject wrong defining level/family, such as aortic outflow in ME4C/TG2C or valve-free ascending aorta for AV SAX.
Within plausible family, reduce target-to-plane distances and improve continuous retained target extent; discourage foreshortening and unnecessary tissue loss.
Inspect actual grayscale samples over neighboring offsets and rotations; regional tint supports context but does not prove target identity.
Set field of view and display handedness only after physical-plane review; near/far orientation must agree with clinical approach.

metricGuidance.distance: For candidate normal n and origin c in world millimetres, target point distance is abs(dot(n,p-c)); use verified point/curve targets with explicit uncertainty.
metricGuidance.coverage: Report how many known landmark groups are included and which are not identified. Do not count coarse label voxel fractions as named-structure proof.
metricGuidance.continuity: Use connected source paths across neighboring sections, not only endpoint proximity in one plane.
metricGuidance.shortAxis: Estimate the local target-axis tangent; quantify obliquity separately from longitudinal level. Cardiac long axis is not a patient-body vertical.
metricGuidance.limits: No globally optimal clinical plane, validated annulus, or patient probe trajectory can be inferred from this dataset.

anatomicalContextChecks.relationship: Posterior to LA/pericardium, with variable lateral relation; remain outside cardiac lumina. Use a softly curved, slightly flattened muscular tube.
anatomicalContextChecks.registration: World-fixed authored reference; do not rotate the tract with the chosen CT plane.

anatomicalContextChecks.relationship: Thoracoabdominal partition with distinct domes and central cardiac support; posterior esophageal hiatus leading to short abdominal esophagus.
anatomicalContextChecks.registration: Illustrative shape and position; source heart alone does not provide a measured hiatus or patient body axes.

anatomicalContextChecks.relationship: Cardia below hiatus; fundus extends leftward under left dome; body descends then curves toward antral/pyloric end.
anatomicalContextChecks.registration: Authored outline supporting gastric/deep-gastric spatial understanding, not a donor-segmented organ.

anatomicalContextChecks.relationship: ME originates behind atrial side; TG from gastric wall toward inferior heart; deep TG turns toward apical-to-outflow direction.
anatomicalContextChecks.registration: Clinical insertion centimetres are reference values only; no incisors/esophagus/stomach were captured in the source heart scan.

candidateReview.reviewConclusion: Improved both ventricular/AV-junction regions while retaining aortic-root and outflow territory. Some LV apical foreshortening is acceptable for the five-chamber target.
